sections.overview:
1. 整体市场概况和情绪

今日主要事件：

  • U.S. military halts airstrikes on Iran as Oman-mediated talks make progress: Trump ordered the military on Friday to cancel approved strike plans, breaking a streak of daily airstrikes that had continued for 13 consecutive days. An Omani delegation arrived in Tehran that day to negotiate new arrangements for reopening the Strait of Hormuz. An Iranian army spokesperson subsequently announced a suspension of retaliation against the U.S. Meanwhile, the U.S. and U.K. are planning a meeting in London to form an escort coalition and seek minesweepers, warships, and drones from allies. From a market perspective, this is the weekend's biggest bullish catalyst: SPY closed Friday at 738.29 (+0.03%) and DIA at 518.84 (+0.52%), barely finishing in the green, while QQQ closed at 685.05 (-1.00%), dragged down by technology stocks, revealing severe internal divergence across the indices.
  • Another tanker hits a mine in the Strait of Hormuz: Iranian media outlets Mehr and Tasnim reported that a tanker exploded on Sunday after deviating from an Iranian-designated shipping route and striking a mine, which Iran used to emphasize its "sovereign jurisdiction" over the strait. This directly conflicts with the "ceasefire" narrative—the strait has still not actually reopened to traffic. USO closed Friday at 136.66 (-2.01%), while Brent fell about 4% to around $97, its largest one-day decline since late June, though it still gained roughly 10% for the week.
  • Moody's warns AI capex threatens the credit quality of major technology companies: Moody's specifically named MSFT, AMZN, GOOGL, META, ORCL, and CoreWeave, estimating that their capex will reach $785 billion in 2026 and approach $1 trillion in 2027. The six companies have approximately $460 billion in direct debt and $1.2 trillion in cumulative lease commitments. This provides authoritative backing for the community's "capex fear." ORCL closed Friday at 115.005 (-4.20%), META at 595.18 (-1.77%), and AMZN at 232.10 (-0.64%).
  • Memory and semiconductor chains suffer a Friday bloodbath: SNDK closed at 1441.93 (-10.52%), MU at 920.55 (-6.88%), SOXL at 137.12 (-12.88%), AMD at 522.03 (-3.24%), and INTC at 92.38 (-7.67%) despite significantly beating expectations. In stark contrast, AAPL closed at 333.48 (+3.70%), becoming the only Mag7 stock viewed as a "safe haven."
  • This week's calendar is extremely crowded: The FOMC will meet on 7/28-29, with the decision released Wednesday at 14:00 ET and markets pricing in approximately a 79.5% probability that rates remain at 3.50%-3.75%. MSFT and META report Wednesday, while AAPL and AMZN report Thursday. Approximately 170 S&P companies will report during the same week. GOOGL closed Friday at 319.31 (+0.50%), making it one of the few large-cap technology stocks to finish higher amid the broader selloff.

社区气氛：周末的讨论反映出一种不同寻常的“喧闹的乐观情绪”——TACO 表情包充斥着论坛，大量用户发布了在周一开盘时全力以赴的计划。然而，这种乐观情绪显然更像是被困持有者的报复希望，而不是真正的信念。与此同时，帖子中充斥着自我否定的评论，例如“周一的缺口只是退出流动性”和“真正的地雷是周三的 MSFT/META 资本支出”。总体而言，人们的情绪在狂热和投降之间分裂。

估计的恐惧/贪婪水平：情绪指标仍处于恐惧区域，但社区本身具有双峰分布 - 周一的短期贪婪约为 7/10，而本周收益后的中期恐惧约为 7/10。一些用户明确指出，“这仍然不是极端的恐惧；还会有更多的恐惧。”多个反向指标被反复引用：SPY空头兴趣接近15年来的高点，社区开玩笑说应该“永远反转WSB”，“空头在评论中获得支持是一个看涨信号”。

WSB 情绪与实际市场：明显不同。社区将停火视为“战争结束，周一将满月”，但周五的市场却讲述了一个不同的故事——防御性股票道琼斯指数收高，纳斯达克指数下跌 1%，半导体和内存股暴跌，而苹果公司则飙升 3.7%。这是从高贝塔值到可预测现金流的典型防御性轮换，而不是风险偏好的回归。该社区本身也承认，“伊朗实际上并不是市场下跌的根本原因”，但它仍然押注于跳空缺口。少数人的观点更接近市场所发出的信号：地缘政治只是噪音，而人工智能资本支出和自由现金流才是实际定价的内容。

5. 个股情绪分析

股票行情指示器提及牛/熊情绪核心观点总结
GOOGL30+看涨目前是社区最喜欢看涨的股票，“周一全押GOOG”成为口号。该股在周五科技股广泛抛售中的上涨被视为实力的确认。一些用户发布了看涨的 DeMark Sequential 计数。平均成本为325的持有者希望回到330，而乐观者则呼吁350甚至340以上。逆势担忧包括“每个人买GOOGL都让我害怕”以及r/valueinvesting已经开始讨论这一事实，这被视为一个首要信号。由于双子座经历的恶化，一些长期看多的人正在动摇。资本支出指引较高后，上周财报后抛售的阴影依然存在
